verdict.rationale: Docs reference SDKs, an Inference API, and integrations with agentic tools (Claude Code, Cursor, MCP server) supporting AI-native SDK-based development, but the evidence pack lacks direct SDK documentation (language coverage, install instructions, code samples) or independent developer corroboration specifically about SDK quality. missing for 10: explicit SDK reference docs/examples across languages, independent hands-on validation of SDK usage, and OpenAPI/spec availability (probe found 404s).
